The 2026 official mark (black signet, larger coin slot, red dot) is announced by the bank and published as an original vector attributed to pkobp.pl; a supported rebranding update is justified.

proposals.reason: Existing icon is the pre-2011 PKO Bank Polski signet with an orange (#E0912F) dot. The official mark since 2011 uses a red dot, and on 2026-02-05 the bank announced an evolutionary refresh: simplified signet geometry, larger coin slot, black signet, red dot, new wordmark. The existing icon matches neither current variant, so a supported rebranding update is justified.

sourceCandidate.rationale: Commons original vector of the 2026 PKO Bank Polski logo (metadata: date 2026-02-05, source pkobp.pl, Karol Swiaka rework), corroborated by the bank presentation slide published on press.pl. Self-contained SVG with explicit geometry; the standalone emblem (red dot + black signet subpaths) is selected losslessly and the accompanying 'Bank Polski' wordmark subpaths are omitted for the square cell.
